entities.name: St. Mary's Church, Stargard
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Collegiate church of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen of the World in Stargard, or simply the St. Mary's Church, is a noted architectural monument in Polish Pomerania. It closes the eastern part of the Old Town Market. The monument is a part of the European Route of Brick Gothic. It is a collegiate church, but inhabitants of the town commonly call it "the A Cathedral".
